title: RPN Calculator
prompt:
Evaluate an expression in Reverse Polish Notation (postfix). Tokens are separated by whitespace. A token is either a signed integer (i64) or one of the operators + - * /.

Return errors as a RpnError:
- RpnError::InvalidToken(tok) for a token that is neither an integer nor an operator
- RpnError::StackUnderflow if an operator does not have two operands
- RpnError::DivisionByZero for division by zero
- RpnError::Overflow if any arithmetic overflows i64 (use checked_* methods)
- RpnError::LeftoverOperands(n) if, after processing all tokens, the stack has n != 1 items (this includes n = 0 for an empty expression)

Division truncates toward zero (normal Rust integer division). For "a b -" the result is a - b.

Try to use the ? operator to keep the code flat.

Example:
  eval_rpn("3 4 + 2 *") -> Ok(14)
  eval_rpn("5 1 2 + 4 * + 3 -") -> Ok(14)
  eval_rpn("1 0 /") -> Err(RpnError::DivisionByZero)
